changes: A review outcome carries a structured reviewer; both surfaces take it and report it; the views show it.

decomposition.rationale: The outcome has four kinds of reader, and each boundary must compile and pass.

breakingChanges.guarantee: reviews.run is called with a record id and an optional scope, and answers an outcome with no reviewer
breakingChanges.reason: The request requires every review to be attributed to a structured reviewer, supplied by the caller.
The review panel must show the reviewer's display name and role.

stages.title: The reviewer in the shared vocabulary
The outcome and both surfaces carry the reviewer
stages.note: Every caller of reviews.run moves in the same step.

stages.title: The views show the reviewer
stages.note: The pure view's props and the panel that fills them move together.
